input.state_semantics: complete held state from frame until next event; empty buttons releases all; until is exclusive

croc_action.description: What Croc is doing: 1 moving freely (on the ground or in a jump), 4 stomping, others not ported (attack, hurt, ...)

croc_angle.description: The way Croc faces: 4096 is a whole turn

croc_gait.description: How Croc is moving on his feet

croc_on_ground.description: Croc stands on the ground; false through a jump or a fall

croc_speed_x.description: Croc's horizontal speed along x, as his movement smooths it

croc_speed_z.description: Croc's horizontal speed along z, as his movement smooths it

croc_turn_rate.description: How fast Croc's facing turns, as it builds up while a turn is held

croc_vertical_speed.description: Croc's vertical speed: upward while rising, downward while falling

description: Jump freely for 20-40 s: short taps and held jumps, from standing and while running, steering with left/right and turning with L1/R1 in the air, and pressing jump again just before landing. Never press L1/R1 while Croc stands still on the ground. Take off and land on the grey stone path (at most a step off it), between the start and the far end of the crystals, away from the sloping grass by the rock walls. Don't press jump a second time high in a jump (that stomps).
